about: the manual run: recipe, stock and band rows are hard-coded and merged three ways

branches: no IF/Switch; Ingredients in stock from recipe (combine by Name, keep matches), Merge recipe (enrichInput1 by Name) and Super Band (append) all run once
expect.offline: the template has no external read, model or write: six Code nodes return fixed rows that three Merge nodes join, so every variant runs on the same data; only the manual trigger item differs, and the Code nodes ignore it
